doc: Cloud objects of a patch: mask = patch > 0.5 (strict), scipy.ndimage.label with its default structure, 4-CONNECTIVITY (edge neighbours only: two texels that touch diagonally are two objects; no wraparound), area = texel count * patch_px_km^2 (77.0252 km^2 per texel); returns (share of the cloudy area held by objects larger than 1e5 km^2, median object area in km^2), and (0.0, 0.0) when there is no object. A diagonal pair (2 objects, not 1: the labelling is 4-connected), a vertical pair, an L and a single texel: areas 1, 1, 2, 3, 1 texels (n = 5), median 1 texel, nothing above 1e5 km^2. Diagnostics recomputed by the case through the same label call, not returned by the function: n_objects and areas_km2 (in ndimage.label order: by the raster position of each object's first texel); a port's labelling must produce the same multiset of areas. Integer counts times a float64 constant: exact up to the rounding of a product and a sum, 1e-9.
